_about: MPPP site definitions: the sol range of each block that notebook 03 aligns. Keys are the site names used in folder names (v0p53: mars2020_sol_<first sol, 4 digits>_<site>_colmap; ..._colmap_zcam for the Navcam + Mastcam-Z block). 'sols' = [first, last] sol of the block (inclusive), or since v0p75 a list of visits [[first, last], [first, last], ...] - the first is the main visit (it names the folder mars2020_sol_<its first sol>_...), the others the sols the rover came back on; every visit is selected, and Navcam visits more than 100 sols apart get their own rig rotation (rig epochs). Nearby waypoints (ADD_NEARBY_WAYPOINTS) can still add other visits. Since v0p75 the pipeline's Navcam consensus uses the sites of the navcam_consensus group only (one block per site). 'zcam' = the Mastcam-Z zooms (mm) of the site's Navcam + Mastcam-Z block, a list of 34, 48, 63, 79, 110 ([] = Navcam only; v0p53, replaces 'zcam34': true). 'settings' = notebook 03 overrides for this site (JSON values), applied by scripts/run_sites.py and scripts/align_scape.py. 'no_mask_inference_at' = stations (S###D####) where the mask model is off. Groups name site lists for run_sites.py --group; run_all_sites.bat runs navcam_consensus, run_all_sites_zcam.bat zcam_consensus (each site with the zooms of its 'zcam' list), run_all_sites_zcam34.bat zcam34_consensus (48, 63, 79 and 110 likewise). Edit here, then run check_sites.bat; notebook 03 reads this file (SITES_FILE).
